definitions.explanation: The rubbing and kneading of muscles and joints to relieve tension or pain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧マッサージして⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: To have someone massage my shoulders.

examples.japanese: マッサージ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。

examples.english: To go to a massage parlor.

notes:
マッサージ refers to the therapeutic manipulation of muscles.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- マッサージを{受|う}ける (to receive a massage)
- マッサージをする (to give a massage)
- マッサージに{行|い}く (to go for a massage)
- マッサージ{師|し} (massage therapist)

TYPES:
- {全身|ぜんしん}マッサージ (full-body massage)
- オイルマッサージ (oil massage)
- {足|あし}マッサージ (foot massage)
- マッサージチェア (massage chair)

RELATED TERMS:
- {指圧|しあつ} (shiatsu - Japanese finger pressure massage)
- {整体|せいたい} (chiropractic/osteopathic treatment)
- もみほぐす (to knead/massage thoroughly)
